text: 记者自中国巨石获悉，公司已正式上调9月份电子布价格，其中厚布涨价15%、薄布上涨20%。卓创资讯数据显示，8月31日，主流厂商电子布均价均在10元/米以上，平均价最高值为13.25元/米。
text_en: A reporter learned from China Jushi that the company has officially raised September electronic cloth prices, with thick cloth up 15% and thin cloth up 20%. SCI data shows that on Aug 31, the average price of mainstream electronic cloth manufacturers was above 10 yuan/meter, with the highest average price at 13.25 yuan/meter.
